1. References The “Project” means Design Build for Farmers' Market Grand Entrance and Waste Relocation. “Owner” and “Metro” mean the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County. “Contractor” means Dowdle Construction Group, LLC. , the Design Build Contractor. “Design Team” means all members of Contractor’s design team, including architects, engineers, and consultants. The Design Team shall be under contract with Contractor. Contractor is responsible for providing all design and construction necessary for a complete and properly functioning Project on a “turnkey” basis. The “Work” or the “Project Work” means the design, construction and all related functions and services required to completely fulfill Contractor’s obligations under this Agreement. The Fixed Price for Construction or “FPC” is the price to be paid by Metro for satisfactory construction of the Project, to be established by amendment to this Agreement as set forth herein. Metro’s desired completion date for the Project is: March, 29, 2019.
2. Documents comprising the contract and priority. The following documents comprise the Agreement and shall have priority based on their order as listed: a) Any properly executed amendment, with the most recently executed having priority; b) This document; c) The solicitation issued by Metro for the Project; d) Validly issued purchase orders or notices to proceed issued in accordance with the terms of the Agreement or solicitation; e) Contractor’s response to the solicitation; and f) Metro’s Non-discrimination Program forms.
3. Effective Date. This Agreement shall become effective after its full execution by Contractor and Metro and upon the date of its filing with the Metropolitan Clerk.
4. Compensation This Contract has an estimated value of $1,965,228.00. The contractor shall be compensated for design phase services as specified in Section 10 of this contract agreement. Contractor shall be compensated for Construction Phase Services as specified in Section 15 of this contract agreement. ARCHIVE
